name: AMBITIOUS MISSION
source:
In Sahoro City—

A legend persists. It's believed that whoever collects all 12 stars named "Ambitious" can achieve any desired dream...

And tonight, someone continues to chase this fable within the streets of Sahoro.

"Calling Card: Tonight, I'll be taking the beautiful starry sky of this city. Signed, Phantom Thief Miss Arte."

By pure coincidence, our protagonist, Nezu Mikage, happens to be at the scene of Miss Arte's latest stunt. Surprisingly, he deduces that the true identity of Miss Arte is his classmate, the [i] ojou-sama[/i]  (young lady) Arise Kaguya.

"We can't risk the slightest chance of someone finding out. Hence, I'll show you... I'll ensnare your heart and all the feelings it contains."

Not wanting her secret unveiled, Kaguya attempts to recruit Mikage into the phantom thief group she formed to realize her ambitions, but it doesn't quite go as planned.

At one point, the "orphanage" where Mikage grew up is jeopardized. Making her appearance, Miss Arte swiftly and elegantly protects the institution, revealing a hidden "truth" in the process.

"So, you're not like the typical thief?"

"Exactly. I steal the hearts of those who witness me and leave an indelible impression on them. That's the essence of a [i]kaitou[/i] (phantom thief)."

"I get it. I'll lend my hand. To your [i]yabou[/i]  (ambition) or whatever you call it."

When "Phantom Thief Miss Arte" and "Phantom Thief Midnight" join forces, the curtain rises on a tale revolving around the "truth" shrouded in Sahoro's night.

[Translated from [url=http://sagaplanets.product.co.jp/works/ambitious/]official site[/url]]
translation:
佐幌市内——

一个传奇依然存在。人们相信，谁集齐了全部12颗名为“雄心勃勃”的星星，就可以实现任何想要的梦想……

今晚，有人继续在佐幌的街道上追寻这个传说。

“名片：今晚，我要拍下这座城市美丽的星空。签名，怪盗阿特小姐。”

纯属巧合，我们的主角根津御影恰好出现在阿特小姐最新特技表演的现场。令人惊讶的是，他推断出阿特小姐的真实身份是他的同学，[i]大小姐[/i]（小姐）Arise Kaguya。

“我们不能冒被人发现的哪怕一丝一毫的风险。因此，我会告诉你……我会诱捕你的心以及它所包含的所有感情。”

辉夜不想让自己的秘密被揭露，她试图招募御影加入她为实现自己的野心而组建的怪盗团，但事情并没有按计划进行。

御影长大的“孤儿院”一度受到威胁。阿特小姐一出场，迅速而优雅地保护了该机构，并在此过程中揭示了隐藏的“真相”。

“那么，你不像典型的小偷？”

“没错。我会偷走那些目睹我的人的心，并给他们留下不可磨灭的印象。这就是[i]kaitou[/i]（怪盗）的本质。”

“我明白了。我会伸出我的手。为了你的[i]yabou[/i]（野心）或者无论你怎么称呼它。”

当“怪盗Miss Arte”和“怪盗Midnight”联手时，围绕佐幌夜晚所笼罩的“真相”展开的故事即将拉开序幕。

【翻译自[url=http://sagaplanets.product.co.jp/works/ambitious/]官网[/url]】
